entities.name: Johannes-Rudolf Mühlenkamp
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Johannes-Rudolf Mühlenkamp was a German Waffen-SS officer and divisional commander during World War II who led SS Division Wiking. He was a recipient of the Knight's Cross of the Iron Cross with Oak Leaves.
